description: Record a conversation the member had with a lead — a call, a WhatsApp, an email, a meeting, or a note — in the lead's log, as the member. The first outgoing contact with a new lead marks it "contacted". Only log what the member told you happened; never invent a conversation. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#logLeadActivityTool

at.description: When it happened, ISO (default now; up to 30 days back).

body.description: What was said or agreed, in the member's words.

direction.description: 'out' = the member reached them, 'in' = they reached the member. Not for notes.

name: logLeadActivityTool
